run_mirror_sim_main: run the mirror simulation script to sync a simulated robot policy with a real hardware robot
check_server_exists: check if a gRPC CM server is running at a given IP address and port
create_robot_interface_with_mirror: create a RobotInterface instance configured with mirror simulation settings including mirror IP and port
generate_joint_space_min_jerk_trajectory: generate a minimum jerk joint space trajectory between start and goal positions over a specified time
create_joint_trajectory_executor_policy: create a JointTrajectoryExecutor policy with position and velocity trajectories and PD gain parameters
